Function Documentation

HxResult HxApplicationCriticalBlock ( void   ) 

Set the application in a critical state.

Blocks other applications from launching.

The critical application will receive a 'kHxApplicationBlockedActivate' message when an application launch/switch is blocked.

See also:
HxAppManagerResumeApplicationActivate.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful

HxResult: Returns HX_ACCESS_DENIED if application is not in the foreground.

HxResult HxApplicationCriticalUnblock ( void   ) 

Unblock an application in critical state.

Allow application switching/launching to resume.

Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful

HxResult HxApplicationKeepAlive ( void   ) 

Keep alive current application.

Prevents app manager from killing current application when possible.

Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful

HxResult: Returns HX_ACCESS_DENIED if system cannot keep application alive.
